io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.options

Class ConfigEditorMenu

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.options.ConfigEditorMenu

  • public final class ConfigEditorMenu
extends java.lang.Object
    An admin-only, chest-GUI editor for the whole server config. Sections are folders you click into; booleans toggle, numbers/strings open a chat prompt, lists are shown read-only.

    Gated by config-editor.enabled (default true) and OP / PERMISSION. The config-editor section itself is hidden from the editor, so the feature can only be turned on or off by editing config.yml directly - never from in-game.

    Saving uses the standard config writer, which does not preserve inline comments.
